federations.summary_en: Federation 1 — Cubical dependent type theory, computational univalence, ROBDD face lattices, Hermitian spectral projectors, exact algebraic towers, and BFT/MVCC durable execution.

federations.summary_en: Federation 2 — Finite symmetry groups, colored canonical labeling, Burnside marks, G-sets, finite categories, and Kan extensions.

federations.summary_en: Federation 4 — Grothendieck and elementary toposes, subtopos Lawvere–Tierney nuclei, Kripke–Joyal forcing, groupoid stacks, and nerve cohomology.
federations.summary_zh: 第四聯邦 — Grothendieck 與初等 Topos、子 Topos Lawvere–Tierney 核、Kripke–Joyal 力迫、群胚疊與神經上同調。

federations.summary_en: Federation 5 — Multivariate Gröbner ideals, Zariski/glued schemes, Kähler differentials & Eisenbud Fitting smoothness, Serre duality, blow-ups, and Chow motives.
federations.summary_zh: 第五聯邦 — 多變量 Gröbner 理想、Zariski 黏合概形、Kähler 微分與 Eisenbud Fitting 平滑性、Serre 對偶、吹脹與 Chow 動機。

federations.summary_en: Federation 6 (Lower-V GCD Base + X-Overlap Condensed Pivot) — Universal Elimination-GCD (`@gcd`), 4 Condensed Higher Structures (`CondAnima`, `CondSolidModule`, `CondSpectralSheaf`, `CondAnalyticStack`), 2 Categories (`CondCategory`, `CanonElimCategory`), Steenrod–Adams `Ext_A`, Persistent Invariant Ledger, and 4 Conjectures.
federations.summary_zh: 第六聯邦（下V新最大公因數基底＋X形交疊凝聚樞紐） — 泛消元新最大公因數（`@gcd`）、凝聚高階結構×4（`CondAnima`、`CondSolidModule`、`CondSpectralSheaf`、`CondAnalyticStack`）、範疇×2（`CondCategory`、`CanonElimCategory`）、Steenrod–Adams `Ext_A`、持久不變量賬本與新猜想×4。

federations.summary_en: Federation 7 (Multilinear Tensor Geometry & Lakatosian Conjecture Discovery Loop) — F_3 6,561-tensor Cayley hyperdeterminant & rank atlas, discrete Radon inversion, Clifford Ramond spinors & T^2 gauge moduli, non-crossing sheaves, Vietoris–Rips homology, 6 evolutionary transfer laws, 5 epistemic lenses, and 12 updated conjectures.
federations.summary_zh: 第七聯邦（多線性張量場論與 Lakatos 猜想演化創造聯邦） — F_3 全體 6,561 張量超行列式與秩圖譜、有限平面離散 Radon 反演、Clifford 拉蒙旋量與 T² 規範模空間、非交叉森林層景、VR 持續同調、6 大演化轉移定律、5 大認識論透鏡與 12 項更新猜想。

unification.summary_en: Upper-V & Star-Prism Grand Unification Apex — Seven-federation Double-V, X-Overlap & Lakatosian synthesis, complete K_7 (21/21) pairwise cross-federation bridges, Five-Federation Pentagon theorem, and 18-entry Geometry–Logic Atlas.
unification.summary_zh: 上V與星稜柱大一統匯流頂點 — 七聯邦雙V形、X形交疊與 Lakatos 猜想演化匯流、K_7（21/21）全配對跨聯邦橋、五聯邦五角大一統定理與 18 項幾何—邏輯精細圖譜。

components.summary_en: Certified transcendental & division-free determinant layer: rigorous rational enclosures for e and pi, arbitrary-degree Liouville transcendence refutation certificates, Schanuel Q-rank witnesses, and Berkowitz-CRT division-free charpoly.
components.summary_zh: 超越數與無除法特徵多項式認證層：e 與 π 嚴格有理包絡、任意次數 Liouville 代數無理數可複核否證證書、Schanuel ℚ-線性無關秩見證與 Berkowitz–CRT 無除法特徵多項式。

components.summary_en: Runtime hot loading for the compiled module environment: interface-hash gating, transactional swaps with consistency verification and rollback, and an audit log of every attempt.
components.summary_zh: 已編譯模組環境的執行期熱載入：介面雜湊閘控、帶一致性驗證與回滾的交易式替換，以及每次嘗試的稽核日誌。

components.summary_en: Executable model of crash-consistent durable writes and 3f+1 Byzantine Fault-Tolerant replicated quorum consensus over DiskState nodes.
components.summary_zh: 崩潰一致寫入與 3f+1 拜占庭容錯法定人數複製狀態機的可執行模型。

components.summary_en: Decidable higher-order matching: the one-sided fragment of HOU where the right-hand side is ground. Unique solution for distinct-variable spines; bounded enumeration with beta/eta verification otherwise; the bound is part of the answer.
components.summary_zh: 可判定高階匹配：右側無元變數的單側片斷。相異變數脊柱給出唯一解；其餘情形以有界列舉配合 βη 轉換驗證，且 bound 是答案的一部份，永不單獨宣稱無解。

components.summary_en: Stasheff associahedra K_n for arbitrary n: Schroder-tree face lattice, f-vector, Euler characteristic, and the pentagon/square 2-face property, cross-checked against the Tamari rotation graph.
components.summary_zh: 任意 n 的 Stasheff 結合多面體 K_n：Schröder 樹面格、f-向量、Euler 示性數與二維面必為五邊形或正方形，並與 Tamari 旋轉圖互相對帳。

components.summary_en: Blakers-Massey and Freudenthal: decidable connectivity arithmetic, the stable range derived from the gap formula, and long-exact-sequence algebra over finitely generated abelian groups, yielding pi3(S2) = pi3(S3) and pi3(S3) = pi2(S2) with explicit provenance.
components.summary_zh: Blakers–Massey 與 Freudenthal：可判定的連接度算術、由間隙公式推導的穩定範圍、以及有限生成交換群上的恰當序列代數，給出 π₃(S²) ≃ π₃(S³) 與 π₃(S³) ≃ π₂(S²)，並附顯式來源鏈。

components.summary_en: Brunerie's proof that pi_4(S^3) = Z/2Z: join and Whitehead degree arithmetic, James construction cells, the Hopf LES reduction to pi_4(S^2), cyclic group arithmetic Z/beta Z, and Theorem 6.17's decision rule, with imported ingredients counted explicitly.
components.summary_zh: Brunerie 證明 π₄(S³) ≃ ℤ/2ℤ：join 與 Whitehead 次數算術、James 構造胞、Hopf LES 化約至 π₄(S²)、ℤ/βℤ 循環群算術，以及定理 6.17 判準；import 成分由測試明數。

components.summary_en: General homotopy type formers (join, wedge, n-truncation, James construction) declared as genuine DHitSpec HITs with recursion principles and computation rules.
components.summary_zh: 通用同倫型別構造子（join、wedge、n-截斷、James 構造）以 DHitSpec 宣告為真正的 HIT，並給出遞迴原則與計算規則。

components.summary_en: Lower-V Universal Elimination-GCD engine: exact F_p RREF/nullspace/rank/det, Z-matrix Hermite & Smith Normal Forms, and 5-domain universal GCD (Int, F_p[x], F_p-subspace, Z-lattice, Bezout Z-ideal).
components.summary_zh: 下V泛消元新最大公因數核心引擎：精確 F_p RREF／核空間／秩／行列式、ℤ-矩陣 Hermite 與 Smith 範式，以及五域統一泛 GCD（整數、F_p[x]、F_p 子空間、ℤ-格、Bézout 整數主理想）。

components.summary_en: X-Overlap Condensed Mathematics core: 4 Condensed Higher Structures (`CondAnima`, `CondSolidModule`, `CondSpectralSheaf`, `CondAnalyticStack`), 2 Categories (`CondCategory`, `CanonElimCategory`), Steenrod–Adams `Ext_A`, Persistent Invariant Ledger, and 4 Conjectures.
components.summary_zh: X形交疊凝聚數學核心：凝聚高階結構×4（`CondAnima`、`CondSolidModule`、`CondSpectralSheaf`、`CondAnalyticStack`）、範疇×2（`CondCategory`、`CanonElimCategory`）、Steenrod–Adams `Ext_A`、持久不變量賬本與新猜想×4。

components.summary_en: Multilinear 2x2x2 hyperdeterminants & F_3 6561-tensor rank atlas, discrete Radon transform & inversion, Clifford Ramond spinors & torus gauge moduli, non-crossing chord sheaves, Vietoris–Rips persistent homology, and Krasner hyper-structures.
components.summary_zh: 多線性 2×2×2 超行列式與 F_3 6561 張量秩圖譜、離散 Radon 變換與反演、Clifford 拉蒙旋量與環面規範場模空間、非交叉弦層景、Vietoris–Rips 持續同調與 Krasner 超結構。

components.summary_en: Lakatosian Conjecture & Theorem-Creation Engine: [E-Derive]+[P-Transfer] evolutionary discovery across 6 trajectories, 5 epistemic relational lenses, and 12 updated cross-federation conjectures.
components.summary_zh: Lakatos 猜想演化與定理創造引擎：6 大軌跡 [E-Derive]+[P-Transfer] 守恆律自動發現、5 大認識論關係透鏡與 12 項跨聯邦更新猜想。
